scope: Three-phase SiC/PyC/SiC periodic tow elastic stochastic simulation; no calibration or fracture claim.
assumptions: Supplied constituent ranges motivate input bounds; independent uniform distributions and delta=0.03 are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not identified statistics.
PyC is represented here by an effective isotropic bulk layer; nu=0.2 is assumed. Tangential anisotropy and interface traction separation are not represented.
This hexagonal tow is not a woven coupon. Small n is a smoke test; inspect interface-resolution warnings and refine before physical conclusions.
All samples use the identical absolute strain history. Normal stresses except the loading direction and all shear stresses are free in the macroscopic average.
